Following today's "surprise announcement" event, Apple has updated its official design resources website with new product frame assets for iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro. Details below.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro frame assets now available

Designers should be no strangers to Apple's design resources website, which provides various hardware and software assets for them to use in their own work.

These assets cover Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG, and SVG files for Apple platforms, products, and technologies, as well as fonts, SF Symbols, Apple's Icon Composer, and logos and badges for services like Apple Health and Apple Wallet.

After announcing iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro today, Apple has updated its design resources website with Photoshop and PNG assets for these two new devices.

The assets include both the unfolded and folded forms of iPhone Duo, available in two color versions, as well as the iPhone 18 Pro model featuring a smaller Dynamic Island.

To view the new frame assets and other existing assets on Apple's design resources website, click here.
